subject: Request: Runtime headcount to cover kernel latency sprint (HC slot + comp guidance)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Runtime headcount to cover kernel latency sprint (HC slot + comp guidance)

Hi Kimberly / Marcus —

Quick ask: the kernel squad is behind on two high-priority latency optimizations (KV-prefetch and fused-attn kernel tuning). We scoped an intensive 8-week sprint and need a mid-senior SWE (runtime/kernel focus) to avoid slipping multiple customer SLAs and Q1 throughput targets.

Why now:
- Current team capacity is ~2.1 FTE-equivalent after recent rotations; anticipated ramp for our ICs collides with the DLO (production) timeline.
- These are high-leverage infra fixes: conservatively we estimate 18–24% p99 improvement for typical inference workloads once complete.

Request details:
- Headcount: 1 additional runtime/kernel SWE (12-month funded slot, priority allocation)
- Suggested level: Senior (SWE III) or strong SWE II with kernel background
- Comp guidance: see attached proposed-comp-band-2026-q4.xlsx — leaning toward band 4 (US market midpoint $225k–$260k total comp) given market scarcity for quantized-kernel experience.
- Target start: rolling, ideally onboarded by 01/11/2027 to hit Q1 milestones.
- Budget code: INF-RN-2026-Q4 (charge to infra runway)

Attachments: HC justification packet and comp-band proposal.

Next steps I’m proposing:
1) Kimberly: approval to convert one pool slot to a funded 12-mo role (or approve one new slot if capacity allows).
2) Marcus: advise on comp band and whether we should elevate to Senior.
3) If both OK, we route to PeopleOps + Talent Ops for the req + posting.

Thanks — short on time so keen to get a fast yes/no. Happy to jump on a 15 if helpful.

—
Rafael Mendes
Head of Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Runtime headcount to cover kernel latency sprint (HC slot + comp guidance)

Rafael —

Thanks for the concise ask and the attachments. A few clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Can you confirm the expected 12-month burn and whether this is additive to the FY26 hiring plan or a reallocation? (I need this for finance signoff.)
2) Headcount priority: is this mission-critical vs. nice-to-have? You indicate SLA risk — can you point to one or two customer-impact examples we can cite in the memo?
3) Comp band: if you want band 4 we’ll need a short justification for why this role should be at band 4 vs band 3 for the posting.

If we can get quick answers I can route to PeopleOps. If finance needs a code change I’ll loop them.

Also cc’ing Mina so she can advise on whether we have a pooled slot available in the infra tranche this quarter.

Kimberly Park
VP, Headcount & Talent Operations
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Runtime headcount to cover kernel latency sprint (HC slot + comp guidance)

Kimberly / Rafael —

Short answers:
1) Budget burn: 12-month slot approx $210k–$250k fully loaded depending on level (SWE II vs SWE III). If we position as SWE III (band 4) expect to be toward the top end.
2) Priority: I concur this is mission-critical — we have two customers ("BlueSky Analytics" and "EduLabs Inc.") with upcoming contract renewal clauses tied to p99 targets; engineering delay here risks a credit/penalty clause. I can share the renewal excerpts if helpful.
3) Recommendation: post as SWE III but allow strong SWE II candidates; include explicit kernel/attention/quantization experience in the JD. Set the hiring range $175k–$255k base+equity comp band with interview loop gating on kernel technical bar.

Operational ask: if we approve today I can reallocate one provisional contractor slot (from the search infra backlog) and convert it to a 12-month funded slot to speed the req. That avoids shifting other squads.

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Infrastructure
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
